mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 54 degrees with mainly clear skies around Verona City Hall under a waxing gibbous moon.

The City of Verona announced that Fall Leaf Collection begins on Monday, October 5, with residents reminded to place leaves behind the curb rather than in the street. Additionally, the Plan Commission will meet on October 5 to review various development projects, including site plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park.

Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, the Verona Fall Fest at Hometown USA Festival Park, and more live music at Lake Lou-ee.

Regarding recent activity, on September 5, officers investigated a series of incidents where vehicles were found with slices of cheese on their windshields, identifying it as a viral social media prank.
While the store is currently closed, you can look forward to stopping by when it opens today at 10:00 AM to enjoy the flavor of the day.
